costs.scope: Derived CPU-only report; no acceptance decision, new test or inference request.

limits: Requested sizes do not measure allocator retention, process RSS or system DRAM.
Table payload is counted once per active service, never once per request.
Constant length comparison is inside query_ns; numeric_ns must not be added again.

lifecycle-full.limit: These concrete HTTP cases do not prove arbitrary-input state equivalence.

lifecycle-subset.limit: These concrete HTTP cases do not prove arbitrary-input state equivalence.

phase_limits: All eight current timing requests have zero admitted suffix steps; these phases describe neural fallback at old-8k/old-45k, not isolated suffix cost in long repetitions.
Whole-generation work includes the first MTP round and ordinary-tail forwards, excludes initial main/MTP prefill. TTFT/decode throughput uses its separately frozen E2E accounting.
CUDA events include stream idle and values are rounded to 0.1ms; extend+accept includes restore/accept/seed handling and does not isolate restore cost.
Cancellation has only extend lower/upper bounds; committed work may exceed received pieces.
CPU numeric_ns is within query_ns; index/table requested bytes do not prove physical-RAM delta or allocator return.

scope: Compact derivative; full analysis/raw values/seals remain at original paths and in the independent research archive.
